title: spec(ui): `reportForm`'s "Joined blocks" row offers a block's `dataset` as free text with no `required`, so Studio saves the block #21702 now refuses
body:
Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`, grading objectstack-ai/objectui#11601. That card's direction asked which side the fix lands on, and both sides do. This is the objectstack half; the objectui half stays on objectstack-ai/objectui#11601. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#11601

## What

`packages/spec/src/ui/report.form.ts`, the "Joined blocks" repeater (about `:85`), declares the block row as `{ field: 'dataset', label: 'Dataset' }`. It has no `widget` and no `required`. The top-level binding (`:39`) already declares `widget: 'ref:dataset'`.

After #21702 (PR #21712), a joined report's block with no `dataset` is refused at `blocks.N.dataset`. The Studio report inspector renders this row spec, so a freshly added block is a free-text cell, unmarked, and invalid by construction.

## Measured (objectui `origin/main` `278d2444ee`)

- **The row spec decides the control.** `SchemaForm.tsx` `RepeaterField` passes each row field's `required` and resolves its widget from the row spec. The grid cell (about `:2797`–`:2810`) uses `required={Boolean(s.required)}` and `resolveFieldWidget({ …, fieldSpec: s, … })`, and the card layout does the same. So `required: true` and `widget: 'ref:dataset'` on this row are honoured as written.
- **`ref:dataset` is not a registered widget yet.** `widgets.tsx` `WIDGETS` registers `ref:object` and `ref:component` only (about `:2935`). An unregistered widget hint resolves to the raw-JSON face (`SchemaForm.tsx` about `:870`).
- **The top-level picker is the inspector's own.** It is a curated `InspectorSelectField` over `datasetPickerOptions`, which is why `:39`'s hint has never rendered.

## Change

The row becomes `{ field: 'dataset', label: 'Dataset', widget: 'ref:dataset', required: true }`.

## Order, and why this card is blocked

- **The `widget` line waits for objectui#11601's renderer.** Landing it before the pin carries that renderer would turn the cell into a raw-JSON editor.
- **The unlock keys on the install face:** objectstack's `.objectui-sha` carries objectui#11601's merge.
- **`required: true` alone is safe today.** PR #21712's holder may add it there; if so, this card shrinks to the `widget` line.

## Pins

- `report.form.ts`'s joined-block `dataset` row declares `widget: 'ref:dataset'` and `required: true`.
- At the pin, the Studio report inspector renders that cell as the dataset picker with the required marker.

`priority:p2` (#21702's priority) · `domain:spec` · `area:reports`.
